title: AI and Automation Specialist
description: About Hello There CollectiveHello There Collective is a social-first creative and growth agency connecting culture to conversion.We partner with leading brands across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, technology, and consumer products, bringing together social media, influencer marketing, content production, paid media, and social commerce in one integrated model.At the center of our business is The Collective, our network of tens of thousands of creators, supported by a growing ecosystem of data, performance intelligence, and technology.We're a fast-moving, entrepreneurial team that believes the future of marketing belongs to companies that combine exceptional creativity with smarter technology and more efficient execution.As we continue to scale, we're investing in AI and automation to fundamentally improve how our teams operate.The OpportunityWe're looking for a highly resourceful, technically capable AI & Automation Specialist to help build the next generation of Hello There's internal operating systems.This is a hands-on role for someone who loves building, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, developing automations, and solving real business problems.You'll work across Account Management, Creative, Influencer Marketing, Social, Paid Media, Analytics, and Operations to identify inefficiencies and create practical solutions that save time, improve accuracy, and make teams more productive.From turning meeting notes into automated project workflows to building AI agents that support creator research, reporting, and creative operations, you'll play a central role in how Hello There integrates AI into everyday work.We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to use AI tools. We're looking for someone who can build systems that make an entire company smarter and more efficient.What You'll Do1. Develop Internal AI Tools & SystemsBuild and maintain custom AI assistants and agents for different departments.Support the development of Hello There's internal AI knowledge systems.Create tools that make internal knowledge, processes, and company information easier to access.Develop reusable solutions that can scale across the business.Evaluate emerging AI platforms and recommend opportunities for implementation.Work with leadership to prioritize AI initiatives based on business value.4. Systems Integration, Data & SecurityConnect internal tools and platforms through APIs, webhooks, and automation technologies.Maintain reliable data flows and troubleshoot integration issues.Ensure systems are appropriately documented, monitored, and maintained.Follow data privacy, security, and access-control best practices.Help establish responsible AI procedures for handling confidential client and company information.Maintain visibility into the company's AI tools and subscriptions.5. Drive AI Adoption Across the CompanyWork with team leaders to identify opportunities for automation.Introduce new tools and workflows that meaningfully improve productivity.Create documentation and simple training materials.Help employees understand how to leverage AI effectively.Monitor usage and measure the impact of implemented solutions.Stay current on emerging AI technologies and proactively bring forward ideas.QualificationsRequired2–5 years of relevant experience in AI implementation, automation, software development, business systems, or a related technical function.Demonstrated experience independently building and deploying working automations or internal tools.Strong experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar workflow automation platforms.Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or another programming language.Experience connecting applications using APIs, webhooks, and integrations.Hands-on experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other challenges.Ability to translate business problems into practical technical solutions.Excellent organization, communication, and project management skills.PreferredExperience working in a marketing agency, creative agency, technology company, or fast-growing organization.Advanced knowledge of Monday.com, Slack, and Google Workspace.Experience with AI agent frameworks, RAG systems, vector databases, or orchestration tools.Familiarity with SQL, databases, dashboards, and business intelligence platforms.Knowledge of marketing tools such as Meta, TikTok, Google Analytics, and creator marketing platforms.Experience building internal applications or custom dashboards.Familiarity with AI creative tools for image, video, and content production.Understanding of data privacy, security, and AI governance.Who You AreA builder: You don't just recommend tools. You create working solutions and get them into production.Naturally curious: You're constantly experimenting with new technology and thinking about where it could have an impact.Proactive: You identify problems and opportunities without waiting for someone to assign them to you.Systems-minded: You think about how to eliminate recurring problems rather than repeatedly fixing them.Practical: You know that the most effective solution isn't always the most complicated one.Resourceful: You're comfortable figuring things out, testing new approaches, and learning quickly.Collaborative: You can work with creative, marketing, and operational teams and translate their needs into functional solutions.Accountable: You take responsibility for the tools you build and ensure they continue working reliably.What Success Looks LikeFirst 30 Days: Understand & IdentifyAudit existing technology, AI tools, and operational workflows.Meet with department leaders to identify inefficiencies.Build a prioritized roadmap of automation opportunities.Implement initial quick wins that eliminate manual work.Days 31–60: Build & ImplementLaunch automations across priority workflows.Develop the first internal AI agents or assistants.Improve integrations between existing platforms.Establish documentation, monitoring, and performance tracking.Days 61–90: Optimize & ScaleExpand successful automations across additional teams.Improve the reliability and usability of existing workflows.Measure time saved, tasks automated, and efficiency gained.Present a longer-term roadmap for AI and technology development.Why Join Hello There Collective?We're at an exciting stage of growth, and AI is central to how we're building the next version of our company.You'll have the opportunity to work directly with leadership, influence how teams operate, and implement technology across a rapidly growing creative and marketing organization.This isn't a role where AI initiatives stay theoretical.
